question: For female patients diagnosed with 'SLE' who had lab tests between 1987-07-06 and 1996-01-31 with GPT > 30 and ALB < 4, find those whose earliest qualifying lab year includes at least one November and one December T-CHO result. Return each patient once with their ID, age at that year, and the percentage decrease from the latest November T-CHO to the earliest December T-CHO in that year.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_labs AS (
    SELECT
        P."XCL_058" AS patient_id,
        P."XCL_060" AS dob,
        L."XCL_015" AS lab_date,
        L."XCL_026" AS tcho_value,
        STRFTIME('%Y', L."XCL_015") AS lab_year,
        STRFTIME('%m', L."XCL_015") AS lab_month
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
    WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
      AND P."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
      AND L."XCL_015" BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
      AND L."XCL_020" > 30
      AND L."XCL_031" < 4
),
patient_earliest_year AS (
    SELECT patient_id, MIN(lab_year) AS earliest_year
    FROM qualifying_labs
    GROUP BY patient_id
),
yearly_monthly_tcho AS (
    SELECT ql.patient_id, ql.lab_year, ql.lab_month, ql.tcho_value, ql.lab_date, ql.dob
    FROM qualifying_labs ql
    INNER JOIN patient_earliest_year pey
      ON ql.patient_id = pey.patient_id AND ql.lab_year = pey.earliest_year
),
yearly_eligibility AS (
    SELECT patient_id, lab_year,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lab_month = '11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_november,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lab_month = '12' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_december
    FROM yearly_monthly_tcho
    GROUP BY patient_id, lab_year
),
final_candidates AS (
    SELECT patient_id, lab_year
    FROM yearly_eligibility
    WHERE has_november = 1 AND has_december = 1
),
november_tcho AS (
    SELECT ymt.patient_id, ymt.lab_year,
        (SELECT ymt2.tcho_value FROM yearly_monthly_tcho ymt2
         WHERE ymt2.patient_id = ymt.patient_id AND ymt2.lab_year = ymt.lab_year
           AND ymt2.lab_month = '11'
         ORDER BY ymt2.lab_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_nov_tcho
    FROM yearly_monthly_tcho ymt
    INNER JOIN final_candidates fc ON ymt.patient_id = fc.patient_id AND ymt.lab_year = fc.lab_year
    WHERE ymt.lab_month = '11'
    GROUP BY ymt.patient_id, ymt.lab_year
),
december_tcho AS (
    SELECT ymt.patient_id, ymt.lab_year,
        (SELECT ymt2.tcho_value FROM yearly_monthly_tcho ymt2
         WHERE ymt2.patient_id = ymt.patient_id AND ymt2.lab_year = ymt.lab_year
           AND ymt2.lab_month = '12'
         ORDER BY ymt2.lab_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS earliest_dec_tcho
    FROM yearly_monthly_tcho ymt
    INNER JOIN final_candidates fc ON ymt.patient_id = fc.patient_id AND ymt.lab_year = fc.lab_year
    WHERE ymt.lab_month = '12'
    GROUP BY ymt.patient_id, ymt.lab_year
)
SELECT
    fc.patient_id,
    CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', fc.lab_year || '-12-31') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', ymt.dob) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_year,
    (nt.latest_nov_tcho - dt.earliest_dec_tcho) * 100.0 / nt.latest_nov_tcho AS pct_decrease
FROM final_candidates fc
INNER JOIN november_tcho nt ON fc.patient_id = nt.patient_id AND fc.lab_year = nt.lab_year
INNER JOIN december_tcho dt ON fc.patient_id = dt.patient_id AND fc.lab_year = dt.lab_year
INNER JOIN yearly_monthly_tcho ymt ON fc.patient_id = ymt.patient_id AND fc.lab_year = ymt.lab_year
GROUP BY fc.patient_id, fc.lab_year, ymt.dob, nt.latest_nov_tcho, dt.earliest_dec_tcho

WITH qualifying_labs AS (
    SELECT
        P."XCL_058" AS patient_id,
        P."XCL_060" AS dob,
        L."XCL_015" AS lab_date,
        L."XCL_026" AS tcho_value,
        STRFTIME('%Y', L."XCL_015") AS lab_year,
        STRFTIME('%m', L."XCL_015") AS lab_month
    FROM Patient P
    INNER JOIN Laboratory L ON P."XCL_058" = L."XCL_014"
    WHERE P."XCL_059" = 'F'
      AND P."XCL_064" = 'SLE'
      AND L."XCL_015" BETWEEN '1987-07-06' AND '1996-01-31'
      AND L."XCL_020" > 30
      AND L."XCL_031" < 4
),
patient_earliest_year AS (
    SELECT patient_id, MIN(lab_year) AS earliest_year
    FROM qualifying_labs
    GROUP BY patient_id
),
yearly_monthly_tcho AS (
    SELECT ql.patient_id, ql.lab_year, ql.lab_month, ql.tcho_value, ql.lab_date, ql.dob
    FROM qualifying_labs ql
    INNER JOIN patient_earliest_year pey
      ON ql.patient_id = pey.patient_id AND ql.lab_year = pey.earliest_year
),
yearly_eligibility AS (
    SELECT patient_id, lab_year,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lab_month = '11' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_november,
        MAX(CASE WHEN lab_month = '12' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_december
    FROM yearly_monthly_tcho
    GROUP BY patient_id, lab_year
),
final_candidates AS (
    SELECT patient_id, lab_year
    FROM yearly_eligibility
    WHERE has_november = 1 AND has_december = 1
),
november_tcho AS (
    SELECT ymt.patient_id, ymt.lab_year,
        (SELECT ymt2.tcho_value FROM yearly_monthly_tcho ymt2
         WHERE ymt2.patient_id = ymt.patient_id AND ymt2.lab_year = ymt.lab_year
           AND ymt2.lab_month = '11'
         ORDER BY ymt2.lab_date DESC LIMIT 1) AS latest_nov_tcho
    FROM yearly_monthly_tcho ymt
    INNER JOIN final_candidates fc ON ymt.patient_id = fc.patient_id AND ymt.lab_year = fc.lab_year
    WHERE ymt.lab_month = '11'
    GROUP BY ymt.patient_id, ymt.lab_year
),
december_tcho AS (
    SELECT ymt.patient_id, ymt.lab_year,
        (SELECT ymt2.tcho_value FROM yearly_monthly_tcho ymt2
         WHERE ymt2.patient_id = ymt.patient_id AND ymt2.lab_year = ymt.lab_year
           AND ymt2.lab_month = '12'
         ORDER BY ymt2.lab_date ASC LIMIT 1) AS earliest_dec_tcho
    FROM yearly_monthly_tcho ymt
    INNER JOIN final_candidates fc ON ymt.patient_id = fc.patient_id AND ymt.lab_year = fc.lab_year
    WHERE ymt.lab_month = '12'
    GROUP BY ymt.patient_id, ymt.lab_year
)
SELECT
    fc.patient_id,
    CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', fc.lab_year || '-12-31') AS INTEGER) - CAST(STRFTIME('%Y', ymt.dob) AS INTEGER) AS age_at_year,
    (nt.latest_nov_tcho - dt.earliest_dec_tcho) * 100.0 / nt.latest_nov_tcho AS pct_decrease
FROM final_candidates fc
INNER JOIN november_tcho nt ON fc.patient_id = nt.patient_id AND fc.lab_year = nt.lab_year
INNER JOIN december_tcho dt ON fc.patient_id = dt.patient_id AND fc.lab_year = dt.lab_year
INNER JOIN yearly_monthly_tcho ymt ON fc.patient_id = ymt.patient_id AND fc.lab_year = ymt.lab_year
GROUP BY fc.patient_id, fc.lab_year, ymt.dob, nt.latest_nov_tcho, dt.earliest_dec_tcho
